question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s firm grip on the Chinese Communist Party, reinforced by ongoing high-level purges of military and civilian officials, underpins the strong trader consensus against his removal before 2027. Recent actions, including expected expulsions of over 40 Central Committee members at the Fifth Plenary Session, demonstrate continued efforts to eliminate potential rivals and enforce loyalty ahead of the 21st Party Congress scheduled for late 2027. At age 73, Xi has shown no public signs of stepping down or naming a successor, and earlier rumors of health issues or elite challenges in 2025 have not materialized. While a sudden health event or unforeseen internal realignment could theoretically alter this trajectory before year-end, the absence of any confirmed developments supporting an early exit sustains the elevated implied probability that he remains in power through the end of 2026.
